about: IN-5, the cold open: New game wakes you beside the crashed sky train on the prepared first run's landing (game/data/firstRun.json's crash site; cutscene/crash-scene.js). Chosen climbs out of the wreck, Kappi checks on you, the cargo's three pyramids pop open into the starters, you pick one, Kappi hands over 5 pyramids and a potion and points the way, and the run starts where you stand. Filmed on the landing (landing: spots and shots are metres from its mast). Lines: drafts for the owner.
script: [surprised] Chosen: You’re awake! Good. I was going to carry you, but I’m more of a [i]leader[/i] than a lifter. #l:3dc6
Kappi: Don’t sit up too fast. The train came down, and everyone walked away from it.[p] Even the train, nearly. #l:4976
Chosen: Do you remember your name? No? Don’t worry. Mine came to me in a dream.[p] It was “Chosen”. #l:70df
Kappi: Just before we hit, there was a square of light on the rails ahead. [i]Square.[/i][p] Nobody else saw it. #l:9009
[happy] Chosen: I saw it. I see everything. Right now I see that we need a plan. #l:3ea3
Chosen: The cargo held three Billies. Every hero needs a companion.[p] Not me, obviously. [b]You.[/b] #l:4ee2
Chosen: Three Billies, three types. Each one beats one of the others. Choose wisely.[p] Like I would. #l:fb3f
[happy] Chosen: {starter}! Bold. I’d have picked that one too.[p] I didn’t. But I [i]would[/i] have. #l:1b2d
Kappi: The cargo had five pyramids and a potion too. Take them. A tired wild Billie is easier to keep. #l:d273
caption 2.6 From the cargo | 5 Pyramids and a Potion
Kappi: The station’s rescue beacon is at the far end of this valley. The arrows at the edge point the way. #l:4f1c
[happy] Chosen: We’ll guard the wreck. Bravely.[p] From here. #l:b089
